requirements.text: The bookkeeping system shall process financial transactions within 2.5 seconds while ensuring robust security measures.
The system shall support concurrent processing of up to 80 users to optimize energy consumption while maintaining adequate throughput.
The system shall implement prioritized error handling mechanisms to ensure reliability during transaction processing.
The system shall maintain an immutable audit trail of all transactions for a minimum of 7 years.
The system shall validate currency conversions to ensure accuracy and prevent financial discrepancies.
The system shall ensure compliance with applicable financial regulations and standards.
The system shall implement user access controls to ensure that only authorized personnel can modify transactions.
The system shall log all financial transactions with timestamps and user identifiers to maintain transparency.
The system shall implement energy-efficient algorithms to minimize energy consumption during data processing.
The system shall support document digitization to reduce paper usage by at least 80%.
